headline: prediction-markets-explained score rises 54 to 62; horror-stories cools to 48%
paragraphs: Biggest score move since yesterday: prediction-markets-explained rose from 54 to 62 and gained a channel (38). Its breakout rate (39%) and typical best outlier (3.2x) did not change, and only 3 of its top 12 titles name a prediction market.

Cooling: horror-stories breakout rate fell from 57% to 48% (score 75, was 77), and 7 of its top 12 titles are in Hindi or Hinglish. Typical best outlier fell from 19x to 12.9x in philosophy-stoicism and from 16.8x to 12.3x in true-crime.

New breakouts: Amelia Revenge Stories' bank-deposit video at 116.4x (14,547 views, 718 subscribers) and suyuto's Stoicism video at 68.9x (35,395 views, 2,920 subscribers). Added rail-explainers and sci-fi-stories. Thumbnails not viewable; titles only.
